I have been debating between two tool ideas:

Dev Tool: A private, local-first tool to work seamlessly across remote machines and networks.
OSINT Tool: Auto-gathers scammer info from phishing emails/burner numbers into standardized reports.

Full details for each tool can be found here:
🔸 Dev Tool: https://codeberg.org/SpudWorks/Ideas/src/branch/main/Dev_Tool.md
🔸 OSINT Tool: https://codeberg.org/SpudWorks/Ideas/src/branch/main/OSINT_Tool.md

Which one would you use?
